title: Super El Niño could lead to mega CO2 emissions from fires in Indonesia | New Scientist
description: Intense fires are already burning in Indonesia, and there could be much worse to come as the Super El Niño ramps up
author: Michael Le Page

title: Strange gamma-ray signal could be most direct evidence of dark matter yet | New Scientist
description: Researchers spotted an unusual gamma-ray signal in three galaxy clusters, which may be a telltale sign of dark matter – or some even more exotic phenomenon
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Will personalised mRNA vaccines transform cancer treatments? | New Scientist
description: A personalised mRNA cancer vaccine has produced positive results in a final-stage trial involving skin cancer, raising hopes that this approach could work against many cancers
author: Michael Le Page

title: Two emerging tick viruses that can be deadly are spreading in the US | New Scientist
description: Heartland virus and Bourbon virus, which are transmitted by lone star ticks, have killed at least seven people in the US
author: Alice Klein

title: Depression doesn't shrink the brain like we thought it did | New Scientist
description: For the past decade, depression has been linked to a shrunken hippocampus, which has a vital role in memory. But a large study using up-to-date scanning techniques suggests this may not be the case
author: Chioma Eve

title: NASA calls off rescue effort to save doomed telescope | New Scientist
description: The Swift observatory will now re-enter Earth’s atmosphere in a few months, after a mission to boost it higher failed
author: Jonathan O’Callaghan
